title: Man's Late Night McDonald's Run Turns Into A Complete Disaster
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 17th, 2022. An officer was on routine patrol when he observed a vehicle with no license plate at the back of the car, the officer then observed that he had a temporary license plate at the back window of his car but could not get a read of it due to how dark the tint was. The officer then deemed it was appropriate to conduct a traffic stop, however, the suspect did not slow down but instead drove to his home where he thought he was safe from all traffic infractions. The man did not have a valid license, no insurance and an expired plate. This is footage of the events that followed.
